scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @theale/ethereal && npm run typecheck -w site
scripts.site:build: npm run build && npm run build -w site
scripts.test: npm run build -w @theale/ethereal && npm run test -w @theale/ethereal && npm run test -w site
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:package && npm run verify:registry:published
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run verify:package && npm run verify:registry:local && npm run lint -w site && npm run site:build && npm run test:e2e -w site
